description: This file contains unit tests for the RuntimeManager component, specifically testing the behavior of the RuntimeManager implementation, including methods like Terminate, Hibernate, Wake, Annotate, GetInfo, Run, Suspend, Resume, and event handling for OCI container lifecycle events. It uses Google Test framework with mock objects to simulate various scenarios and validate correct handling of success and failure cases.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for setting up and tearing down the environment for each test case, including creating mock objects, configuring the runtime environment, and providing utility methods for resource management.

methods.name: createResources
methods.description: Sets up mock objects and configures the runtime environment for testing.

methods.name: releaseResources
methods.description: Cleans up mock objects and releases resources after each test.
